title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on Whether the People's Court Shall Accept a Party's Application for Recognition of a Divorce Certificate Issued by an Australian Court

articles.content_en:
The Decision of the Court on Adjusting the Numbers of Articles of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China cited in judicial interpretations and other documents was amended for the first time, and was amended for the second time in accordance with the Decision of the Supreme People's Court on Amending Nineteen Civil Action Judicial Interpretations, Including the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning Civil Mediation Work by the People's Courts, adopted at the 1823rd meeting of the Adjudication Committee of the Supreme People's Court on December 23, 2020.
Higher People's Court of Guangdong Province:
Your court's Request No. Yue Gao Fa Min Yi Ta Zi [2004] No. 9, "Concerning Issues Related to a Party's Application for Recognition of a Divorce Certificate Issued by an Australian Court," has been received. Upon study, we reply as follows:
Where a party holds a divorce certificate issued by an Australian court and applies to the People's Court for recognition of its validity, the People's Court shall accept the case and shall conduct examination in accordance with Articles 281 and 282 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and the relevant provisions of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Issues Concerning the Procedure for Chinese Citizens Applying for Recognition of Divorce Judgments of Foreign Courts, and shall render a ruling of recognition or non-recognition according to law.
This is the reply.
